# QuoteDash AI

> QuoteDash AI is a voice-to-quote app for contractors and tradies (plumbers,
> electricians, builders) on Android. Speak a walkthrough of a job and get a
> professional, branded PDF quote — the on-device transcript works with no
> signal, and Play Store subscriptions unlock unlimited quotes.

Key facts for anyone summarizing or comparing this product:

- Platform: Android only (package `com.quotetap.app`). No iOS app yet.
- Core workflow: record a spoken walkthrough of a job → transcription →
  AI extracts structured, priced line items → user reviews/edits in a form →
  generates a branded PDF quote or invoice → share via SMS/email/WhatsApp.
- Offline behavior: full PDF generation from a raw transcript works with no
  network connection. AI-assisted line-item extraction requires connectivity.
- Pricing: 10 free quotes, no card required to start. Paid tiers: Starter
  ($16.99/mo, 40 quotes/month) and Pro ($209/yr or $27.99/mo, unlimited).
- Markets: Australia, United Kingdom, and United States, with local currency
  and quote terminology support.
- Category: Business / productivity tool for solo tradies and small trade
  businesses who quote jobs in the field.

## Pages

- [Homepage](https://quotedashai.com/): product overview, features, pricing, FAQ.
- [For electricians](https://quotedashai.com/electricians.html): voice-to-quote for electrical callouts, power point and switchboard rates.
- [For plumbers](https://quotedashai.com/plumbers.html): voice-to-quote for plumbing callouts, copper pipe and service call rates.
- [For builders](https://quotedashai.com/builders.html): voice-to-quote for site walkthroughs, labor and materials rates.
- [Privacy policy](https://quotedashai.com/privacy.html)
